messages:
rachel: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need final owners and firm dates for SLO changes and the recurrence-detection work. recurring KVCache stalls hit our generation p95.

omar: I can take the SLO proposal + governance run. will draft measurement queries and rationale today. aim: SLO ticket by EOD tomorrow.

dave: I'll own runtime mitigations (adaptive throttle + batching tweaks). plan: reproduce in staging, then small canary. design doc + PR within 5 business days.

rachel: dashboard/alerts need owner too — who can add per-route p50/p95/p99, burn-rate, and a recurrence rule for repeated root cause tags?

omar: if no one else, I can coordinate with metrics for the queries, but prefer dave or infra to own the dash work.

dave: I can add basic panels in Grafana: per-route p95, QPS, tail lat by model. ETA 48h. will add an alert that triggers when same root_cause tag shows up 3x in 90 days.

rachel: proposed scoped SLO: large-context (ctx>2k or >5 turns) p95 = 250ms, default p95 remains 150ms. this is to avoid penalizing small requests.

omar: scoped SLO needs governance sign-off. i'll open SLO-2026-331 with measurement queries and expected impact. tagging product & reliability.

dave: runtime approach: queue-length + kvcache-hit ratio. if kv-hit<60% && inflight > threshold then throttle or shed long-context. will prototype in preprod.

metrics-bot: Reminder set for 2026-04-01 10:00 UTC to review owners: omar, dave, rachel.

rachel: decision on error-budget reset? i'm inclined to NOT reset. systematically-burned budgets drive prioritization.

omar: agree, keep the burn. we'll document the SLO exception window for long-context traffic while mitigations land.

dave: note: batching reductions might affect throughput on small requests. propose A/B canary: 1% -> 10% before default change. who coordinates infra canary?

rachel: i'll coordinate canary with infra. target batching PR in 3 days, canary plan after that.

omar: dash ticket created: G-9123. includes per-model filters, burn-rate widget, and "jump to traces" link.

dave: PR-5018 draft for throttle prototype posted to staging channel with repro steps and trace links: http://go/trace/INC-2026-442. feedback welcome.

rachel: summary of owners/dates: omar (SLO ticket + governance) - 48h, dave (throttle + batching PR) - 5bd for PR, rachel (canary coordination) - +3d, dash (dave) - 48h. no error budget reset. schedule 2-week follow-up to verify recurrence suppression and validate new metrics.

omar: opening SLO ticket now, will ping product for sign-off.

metrics-bot: Reminder set for 2026-04-15 10:00 UTC for 2-week follow-up.

rachel: thanks all. please update your respective tickets as work progresses and post major updates back here. closing thread for now :thumbsup:
